name: DoubleZigZag
summary: DoubleZigZag is a technical indicator utility for MetaTrader 5 that overlays two ZigZag indicators with different parameters on the same chart. It does not open trades; instead, it helps traders identify swing highs and lows at two different scales to visualize trend structure and potential reversal zones.
summary_zh: DoubleZigZag是一个MT5技术指标工具，在同一图表上叠加两个不同参数的ZigZag指标。它不执行交易，而是帮助交易者在两个不同尺度上识别摆动高点和低点，以可视化趋势结构和潜在反转区域。
strategy_analysis: DoubleZigZag是一个辅助分析工具而非交易EA，它通过叠加两个不同参数的ZigZag指标来提供多尺度的市场结构分析。第一个ZigZag通常使用较小的参数来捕捉短期的摆动高低点，第二个ZigZag使用较大参数来识别中长期的趋势转折点。当两个ZigZag在同一点位重合时，该点位的支撑或阻力意义更强，交易者可以据此判断关键的市场转折区域。该工具本身不包含入场条件、出场条件或仓位管理逻辑，仅作为趋势结构可视化辅助。使用者需要结合自己的交易策略来解读双ZigZag信号，例如在大小ZigZag同向转折时确认趋势变化。资金管理完全依赖于使用者自身的决策，该工具仅提供结构参考。
strategy_analysis_en: DoubleZigZag is an analytical utility rather than a trading EA, providing multi-scale market structure analysis by overlaying two ZigZag indicators with different parameters on the same chart. The first ZigZag typically uses a smaller parameter to capture short-term swing highs and lows, while the second uses a larger parameter to identify medium-to-long-term trend turning points. When both ZigZags converge at the same price point, that level carries stronger support or resistance significance, helping traders identify key market reversal zones. The tool itself contains no entry conditions, exit conditions, or position sizing logic — it serves purely as a trend structure visualization aid. Users must combine this with their own trading strategies to interpret the dual ZigZag signals, such as confirming trend changes when both the small and large ZigZag turn in the same direction. Money management is entirely dependent on the user's own decisions; the tool only provides structural reference points.

parameters.name: ZZ1_Depth
parameters.description: 第一个ZigZag的深度参数，控制短期摆动识别灵敏度
parameters.description_en: First ZigZag depth; controls short-term swing sensitivity

parameters.name: ZZ1_Deviation
parameters.description: 第一个ZigZag的偏差参数，定义最小转折幅度
parameters.description_en: First ZigZag deviation; minimum reversal magnitude

parameters.name: ZZ1_Backstep
parameters.description: 第一个ZigZag的回退参数，控制最近极值点的最小距离
parameters.description_en: First ZigZag backstep; min distance between extrema

parameters.name: ZZ2_Depth
parameters.description: 第二个ZigZag的深度参数，控制中长期趋势转折识别
parameters.description_en: Second ZigZag depth; medium-term trend reversal sensitivity

parameters.name: ZZ2_Deviation
parameters.description: 第二个ZigZag的偏差参数，定义较大级别的最小转折幅度
parameters.description_en: Second ZigZag deviation; minimum larger-scale reversal magnitude

parameters.name: ZZ2_Backstep
parameters.description: 第二个ZigZag的回退参数，控制大级别极值点的最小距离
parameters.description_en: Second ZigZag backstep; min distance between major extrema

pros: 双尺度ZigZag叠加提供多层级市场结构视角，帮助交易者同时看到短期和长期趋势转折
当两个ZigZag在相同点位转折时提供更强的确认信号，提高关键支撑阻力位的识别可靠性
作为纯可视化工具不执行交易，交易者拥有完全的控制权和决策自由度
参数可调，适应不同品种和时间周期的分析需求
pros_en: Dual-scale ZigZag overlay provides multi-level market structure perspective, helping traders see both short-term and long-term trend turning points simultaneously
Stronger confirmation signal when both ZigZags turn at the same price level, improving reliability of key support/resistance identification
As a pure visualization tool with no trade execution, traders retain full control and decision-making freedom
Adjustable parameters allow adaptation to different instruments and timeframe analysis needs
cons: ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，历史信号看起来完美但实时信号可能发生变化，容易造成事后偏误
不提供具体的交易信号或规则，初学者可能难以将双ZigZag结构转化为可执行的交易决策
两个ZigZag参数选择缺乏自适应机制，在波动性变化的市场中可能需要频繁手动调整
缺少声音或推送提醒功能，交易者需持续盯盘才能捕捉转折点
cons_en: ZigZag indicator repaints, making historical signals look perfect while real-time signals may change, creating look-back bias
Does not provide concrete trading signals or rules, making it difficult for beginners to translate dual ZigZag structure into executable trade decisions
Lacks adaptive mechanism for parameter selection, requiring frequent manual adjustment in markets with changing volatility
Missing alert or push notification features, requiring traders to constantly monitor the chart to catch turning points
improvements: 增加报警功能，当两个ZigZag在同一点位转折时发送声音或推送通知
添加自适应参数机制，根据市场ATR或波动率自动调整ZigZag的深度和偏差参数
增加统计面板显示两个ZigZag重合点位的胜率和历史表现，帮助交易者评估信号质量
improvements_en: Add alert functionality to send sound or push notifications when both ZigZags turn at the same price level
Implement adaptive parameter mechanism that automatically adjusts ZigZag depth and deviation based on market ATR or volatility
Add a statistics panel showing win rate and historical performance of confluence points where both ZigZags align, helping traders evaluate signal quality

risk_points: ZigZag指标重绘特性可能导致交易者基于尚未确认的信号做出错误决策
缺乏交易执行功能意味着风险管理完全依赖使用者，无内置风控保护
risk_points_en: ZigZag repainting nature may lead traders to make incorrect decisions based on unconfirmed signals
Lack of trade execution means risk management is entirely user-dependent with no built-in risk controls
